ui.settings.privacy.title.role: Settings section heading and sidebar label
ui.settings.privacy.title.length: Short; sits in the settings rail.
ui.settings.privacy.title.note: Section holding the opt-in usage statistics switch.

ui.settings.privacy.description.note: States sharing is off unless the user turns it on.

ui.settings.privacy.usage_label.length: One line beside a switch or checkbox.
ui.settings.privacy.usage_label.note: Opt-in for anonymous active-user counting. Also used as the optional onboarding checkbox label.

ui.settings.privacy.usage_explanation.role: Help text under the toggle / checkbox
ui.settings.privacy.usage_explanation.note: Must keep all facts: only counts active users; full privacy stays on; no conversations, prompts, files or session details are ever collected, stored or used; can be turned off at any time. Do not add claims about IP addresses or personal data beyond these. Local Operator is a product name: do not translate.

ui.settings.privacy.save_failed.note: Shown when the choice could not be written to disk; the previous choice still applies.

ui.settings.privacy.launch_off.note: Shown when the app was launched with telemetry disabled by its launcher (a test or managed run); the toggle's value has no effect for this launch.
